blockers: Both candidates make factual substitutions and fail unsupported-question boundaries. Neither qualifies for production use.
Training covers 1640 authored finite-domain rows; good training loss does not establish general Japanese understanding or reasoning.
This session has CPU-only PyTorch, 3 available CPU cores and about 9.7 GiB system memory. ChatGPT-level pretraining and evaluation are beyond this experiment and environment.
nextMilestones: Acquire a properly licensed, diverse Japanese dialogue/instruction corpus with counterexamples, abstention cases and source-grounded fact binding; preserve independent test families.
Establish reproducible naturalness/factuality/multi-turn/reasoning evaluation, including human review and out-of-domain boundaries before production use.
Train own language pretraining plus instruction fine-tuning on an appropriately sized compute environment; no existing pretrained weights are required by the implemented architecture.
note: Experimental artifacts are saved for reproducibility. The existing production model is intentionally not replaced. No claim of ChatGPT-level performance or general conversation reliability.
